academic_requirements.summary: A three-year university degree or suitable Italian/foreign qualification is required. L-8 Information Engineering qualifies directly. Other applicants need at least 60 CFU in the listed mathematics, statistics, chemistry, physics, information engineering, industrial engineering and computer science SSDs, including at least 24 CFU in ING-INF/05 and/or INF/01.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: A foreign qualification recognised as suitable, subject to curriculum assessment.
